missing_entities.title: Flow.io: expected entities not found
missing_entities.description: {count} entities expected for prefix "{prefix}" are missing: {entities}. Check the prefix, the pump slots and the firmware's MQTT discovery. Tank and data_* values are only published to Home Assistant when enabled in the firmware. Entities separated by | are alternatives: one of them is enough.

mobile_device_unreachable.title: Flow.io: mobile device unreachable
mobile_device_unreachable.description: Flow.io cannot send notifications to: {devices}. The phone may have been removed from Home Assistant, or its notification service is not available. Check the selection in Configure.

frequent_restarts.title: Flow.io: controller restarting often
frequent_restarts.description: The controller restarted {count} times in the last {hours} hours. Check the power supply, the Wi-Fi signal and the free memory.
